description: Fix 3 bugs found in E2E walkthrough: Ralph loop NaN skip, workflow_log FK failure (2 sources), CLI missing approval state

tasks.title: Fix readTasks() to fill default values for missing task fields
tasks.description: In ralph-executor.ts readTasks(), normalize each parsed task by filling missing fields: attempts→0, passes→false, order→999999, error→null. This prevents NaN arithmetic in the for-loop when agent-generated tasks.json lacks the attempts field.
acceptanceCriteria: readTasks() returns tasks with attempts=0 when tasks.json has no attempts field
readTasks() preserves explicit field values when all fields are present
tasks.notes: See design.md D1. The normalize step goes after JSON.parse and before return.

tasks.title: Fix Ralph loop skip logic to mark passes as false
tasks.description: In ralph-executor.ts runRalphLoop() line ~501, change the skip branch from passes:true to passes:false. Update the error message to reflect the actual reason. This ensures skipped tasks are not incorrectly marked as passed.
acceptanceCriteria: Skipped tasks (no attempts made) are marked passes:false, not passes:true
Error message explains the skip reason
Tasks with at least one attempt use existing success/failure logic unchanged
tasks.notes: See design.md D2. This is a one-line change in the if-block at line ~501.

tasks.title: Fix build stage workflow_log issueId format (workflow-controller + ralph-executor)
tasks.description: Two fixes: (1) In workflow-controller.ts runPipelineBuildStage(), change `const issueId = String(issue.number)` to `const issueId = issue.id`. (2) In ralph-executor.ts runRalphLoop(), separate `sseIssueId` (for eventBus, using issueNumber) and `logIssueId` (for workflow_log, using issueId/UUID).
acceptanceCriteria: workflow-controller writeLog() uses UUID issueId matching issues table
ralph-executor writeTaskLog() uses UUID from context.issueId
ralph-executor eventBus emit continues to use number format (context.issueNumber)
workflowLogRepo.insert no longer fails with FOREIGN KEY constraint in build stage
Plan stage workflow logs remain unaffected
tasks.notes: See design.md D3 and D4. This covers both roots of the FK failure.

tasks.title: Add approval state display to mo issue show
tasks.description: In cli/commands/issue.ts show action, after printing Stage/Status lines, conditionally render approvalState when present. Show status (awaiting/approved/rejected), stage, and selfReviewNotes if present.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue show <n>` displays approval state when present (awaiting/approved/rejected)
No approval line shown when no approvalState
Self-review notes are shown if present in the approval response
tasks.notes: See design.md D5. The API already returns approvalState in the response.
